name: imagen
title: Imagen
description: Versioned, manifest-driven AI image generation and editing sessions with preservation of unchanged regions
author: thales

commands.name: configure
commands.title: Configure Session Storage
commands.description: Set the default session directory and map project roots to dedicated session directories

tools.name: imagen-edit
tools.title: Edit Image
tools.description: Edit an existing image with a prompt, preserving unchanged regions. Appends a new version to a versioned session and returns the new version path.

tools.name: imagen-session
tools.title: Session State
tools.description: Inspect or manage an image session: read the manifest, list versions, check status, or roll back the current version pointer.

tools.name: imagen-generate
tools.title: Generate Image
tools.description: Generate a new image from a text prompt, optionally conditioned on a reference image. Appends a new version to a versioned session and returns the new version path.

tools.name: imagen-commit
tools.title: Commit External Image
tools.description: Ingest an image produced by any external tool (gpt_image, nano_banana, flux-kontext, or a manual file) into a versioned session as a new version, with lock and manifest updates.

preferences.name: bflApiKey
preferences.title: Black Forest Labs API Key
preferences.description: API key for Black Forest Labs (Flux Kontext). Required for the default edit engine.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: API key for OpenAI. Required for the gpt-image generation engine.

preferences.name: geminiApiKey
preferences.title: Google Gemini API Key
preferences.description: API key for Google AI Studio. Required for the nano-banana generation engine.

preferences.name: defaultSessionDir
preferences.title: Default Session Directory
preferences.description: Directory used to store image sessions when no project mapping or explicit path applies.
